About this item

  • CONFIGURABLE HYPERSCROLL TILT WHEEL — Choose between tactile cycling and smooth, free-spin scrolling, or auto-switch between them based on the scroll speed in Smart-Reel mode—now configurable on Synapse
  • RAZER FOCUS PRO 35K OPTICAL SENSOR GEN-2 — Experience best-in-class tracking performance on a wider variety of surfaces including glass, supported by intelligent functions and 1-DPI step adjustments for more granular aim and control
  • UP TO 140 HOUR BATTERY ON RAZER HYPERSPEED WIRELESS — Enjoy smooth, lag-free performance for non-stop play or unlock a true 8000 Hz polling rate with the Razer Mouse Dock Pro or HyperPolling Wireless Dongle (both sold separately)
  • 13 CUSTOMIZABLE CONTROLS — Assign an endless combination of commands and macros across 13 easy-access controls, including its acclaimed multi-function trigger to execute essential actions like push-to-talk, ping, and more
  • 13-ZONE CHROMA LIGHTING WITH FULL UNDERGLOW — Customize each zone from over 16.8 million colors and countless lighting effects, and experience greater immersion as they react dynamically with over 200 Chroma-integrated games
  • RAZER OPTICAL MOUSE SWITCHES GEN-3 — From an improved 90-million click lifecycle with zero double-clicking issues, to a blistering 0.2 ms actuation with no debounce delay, enjoy reliability and speed that outshines all others
  • OPTIMIZE MOUSE ACCURACY — Improve accuracy by disabling the "Enhance pointer precision" option in the Windows mouse settings, and further optimize performance using the Razer Synapse App

  • What is the form factor of the Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K?

    The Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K features a unique right-handed ergonomic design with a signature thumb rest for less finger drag and smoother flicks when gaming.

  • How do I remap buttons and customize settings for the Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K?

    You can configure button mappings, macros, smart-reel mode, level of scroll acceleration, lighting effects and more on Razer Synapse 4.

  • Does the Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K have a tilt scroll?

    Yes. In addition, its tilt scroll wheel can also be programmed for custom functions—just like every other button on the mouse.

  • What does the cover puck at the bottom of the Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K do?

    It covers a compartment that stores the mouse’s wireless dongle when not in use.

  • How does the Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K work with wireless charging?

    With the purchase of the Wireless Charging Puck or Mouse Dock Pro, you can replace the mouse’s cover puck to enable wireless charging. Once the wireless puck has been installed, simply place it on the Mouse Dock Pro or other wireless charging device.

Product Description

Set your immersion to maximum with the Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K—a wireless ergonomic RGB gaming mouse that’s more advanced and customizable than ever.

  • Razer HyperScroll Tilt Wheel – The most advanced 4-way scroll wheel, with 3 unique scroll modes: Tactile Cycling, Free-Spin Scrolling, and Smart-Reel Mode.
  • Adjustable Scroll Tension & Acceleration – Access new customizable scroll options on the new Synapse 4, with 5 levels of scroll tension and 5 multiplier levels of scroll acceleration.
  • Razer Focus Pro 35K Optical Sensor Gen-2 – The most advanced and precise sensor with 1-DPI step adjustments and 99.8% resolution accuracy.
  • Intelligent Features – With Smart Tracking, the sensor can automatically detect and adjust its tracking algorithm to match the surface, maintaining consistent lift-off distance for greater control and accuracy. Enabling Motion Sync allows the sensor to sync its signals to the exact intervals your PC extracts information, ensuring you get the most current updates of your mouse position for more consistent tracking.
  • Tri-Connectivity Mode – Connect the mouse via Razer HyperSpeed Wireless (2.4 GHz), Bluetooth or Wired USB C (for continued usage while charging). Enjoy up to 140 hours on 2.4 GHz, or 210 hours on Bluetooth.
  • Razer Hypershift – Assign a secondary function to each of the mouse’s 13 controls via Synapse and effectively double your command. Instantly toggle between functions with a touch of a button.

    Great gaming mouse
    This is one of the best mouses I ever owned. It is really customizable and the extra buttons help give me an edge in all types of games. You can also program macros into the mouse to allow you to make single fire guns automatic or reduce your recoil if you're smart enough to program it but the programing for the macros is really simple.       Review of the Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K Wireless Gaming Mouse
      Reviewed in the United States on January 14, 2026
      Color: WhiteStyle: Mouse

      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I recently purchased the Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K Wireless Gaming Mouse from Amazon, and I couldn’t be happier with my choice. This mouse has exceeded my expectations in terms of quality, performance, and ergonomics.

      Exceptional Quality

      The build quality of the Basilisk V3 Pro is outstanding. It feels solid and well-constructed, which is essential for a gaming mouse that’s meant to endure hours of use. The materials used are top-notch, providing a premium feel that enhances the overall experience.

      Ergonomics

      One of the standout features of this mouse is its ergonomic design. It fits perfectly in my hand, making long gaming sessions comfortable. The shape and grip are well thought out, allowing for precise movements without causing fatigue.

      Performance

      I’ve been using this mouse for some time now, and I’ve encountered no issues with response time. The tracking is incredibly accurate, which is crucial for competitive gaming. I’ve noticed a significant improvement in my gameplay, thanks to the reliable performance of this mouse.

      Battery Life

      The battery life is impressive as well. Depending on my usage, it lasts up to two days or even three, which is fantastic for a wireless device. I appreciate not having to constantly recharge it, allowing me to focus on my gaming sessions.

      Features and Software

      The Basilisk V3 Pro comes packed with features that enhance its functionality. I downloaded the Razer software, which was straightforward and user-friendly. Customizing settings and adjusting performance options is a breeze, allowing me to tailor the mouse to my preferences.

      Final Thoughts

      Overall, the Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K Wireless Gaming Mouse is a quality investment for any gamer. With its excellent ergonomics, reliable performance, and impressive battery life, it has become an indispensable part of my gaming setup. I highly recommend this mouse to anyone looking for a high-performance gaming accessory!

      5 out of 5 stars
      Works, once ChatGPT helps you configure it
      Reviewed in the United States on December 31, 2025
      Color: BlackStyle: Mouse
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      So far, so good. I got this to replace my old Logitech M720, that until about a month ago was working just fine. Through some combination of updates, either Windows, Logitech, or both, it started giving me issues with click/drag and selection, so the hunt was on for a new mouse. This one is expensive AF, but it had the fastest delivery option. The Razer Synapse software is nightmarishly complicated to figure out. You will need ChatGPT to help you, but it is posible to configure program specific functions for all the buttons. And once you do figure it out, it's easy to use. I have one set to do a Ctrl+click, one to do Ctrl+W, and one to do Enter in chrome, and it works flawlessly. There is zero lag, and I can once again select text with ease, and slide the time bar in Wondershare Filmora to precisely seek to points in videos I'm editing. You can set up multi-step button/mouse actions to happen with a single click with a macro. And if set up properly, the mouse just knows what program it's being used in. You don't have to manually switch button profiles each time you open a different program. That was a major non-negotiable thing for me. I love this thing. No more dropped selections and executions of click commands that I did not initiate. The Logitech is getting the hammer. I'll probably keep this, even though I have two other cheaper ones coming to test. It fits my hand well, and the button placement is equal to, or more convenient than, my old one. It is possible to turn off all of the lights, though I don't know how I did it exactly. I'll have to ask ChatGPT the proper way, but the childish light show is off, which is all that matters.

      I love this mouse, it feels very durable, sturdy, and gives you a lot of ability to customize the mouse bindings. I really like how they did the RGB by having the light bar wrap around the base of the mouse. You get a nice under-glow effect while you use it rather than have RGB on the top and your hand ultimately cover it up during use. The only downside is the side thumb button sits slightly too far forward so it’s not quite as ergonomic of a key press as the other buttons. It’s not that big of a deal to drop the rating but in future models I hope they address this. It’s probably a little heavy to some, but for me that is a benefit and makes it feel premium. I was using a G502x which is a great mouse in its own right but I feel this one is overall better.

I game a lot and have bigger hands, so I spent some time researching, trying to find something that wouldn't result in cramps or awkward grips. I know the fit comes down to grip style, but I never gave it much thought before this purchase. I noticed that my hand very naturally met the form of the mouse, and it stays comfortable to use throughout the day. I will work for a full 8 hours and then spend a few hours in the evening gaming, and it just feels great. I use it with the wireless charging hub, and I have no issues with latency or lag. The charge will last for multiple days if I forget to set it on the charging dock overnight. The mouse feels sturdy and firm with a good weight to it. Never too heavy or cumbersome. The wheel scroll is clean and it has just the right amount of extra buttons for productivity and gaming macros. 100% reccomend.

    About this Item

    • CONFIGURABLE HYPERSCROLL TILT WHEEL — Choose between tactile cycling and smooth, free-spin scrolling, or auto-switch between them based on the scroll speed in Smart-Reel mode—now configurable on Synapse
    • RAZER FOCUS PRO 35K OPTICAL SENSOR GEN-2 — Experience best-in-class tracking performance on a wider variety of surfaces including glass, supported by intelligent functions and 1-DPI step adjustments for more granular aim and control
    • UP TO 140 HOUR BATTERY ON RAZER HYPERSPEED WIRELESS — Enjoy smooth, lag-free performance for non-stop play or unlock a true 8000 Hz polling rate with the Razer Mouse Dock Pro or HyperPolling Wireless Dongle (both sold separately)
    • 13 CUSTOMIZABLE CONTROLS — Assign an endless combination of commands and macros across 13 easy-access controls, including its acclaimed multi-function trigger to execute essential actions like push-to-talk, ping, and more
    • 13-ZONE CHROMA LIGHTING WITH FULL UNDERGLOW — Customize each zone from over 16.8 million colors and countless lighting effects, and experience greater immersion as they react dynamically with over 200 Chroma-integrated games
    • RAZER OPTICAL MOUSE SWITCHES GEN-3 — From an improved 90-million click lifecycle with zero double-clicking issues, to a blistering 0.2 ms actuation with no debounce delay, enjoy reliability and speed that outshines all others
    • OPTIMIZE MOUSE ACCURACY — Improve accuracy by disabling the "Enhance pointer precision" option in the Windows mouse settings, and further optimize performance using the Razer Synapse App

    Product Description

    Set your immersion to maximum with the Razer Basilisk V3 Pro 35K—a wireless ergonomic RGB gaming mouse that’s more advanced and customizable than ever.

    • Razer HyperScroll Tilt Wheel – The most advanced 4-way scroll wheel, with 3 unique scroll modes: Tactile Cycling, Free-Spin Scrolling, and Smart-Reel Mode.
    • Adjustable Scroll Tension & Acceleration – Access new customizable scroll options on the new Synapse 4, with 5 levels of scroll tension and 5 multiplier levels of scroll acceleration.
    • Razer Focus Pro 35K Optical Sensor Gen-2 – The most advanced and precise sensor with 1-DPI step adjustments and 99.8% resolution accuracy.
    • Intelligent Features – With Smart Tracking, the sensor can automatically detect and adjust its tracking algorithm to match the surface, maintaining consistent lift-off distance for greater control and accuracy. Enabling Motion Sync allows the sensor to sync its signals to the exact intervals your PC extracts information, ensuring you get the most current updates of your mouse position for more consistent tracking.
    • Tri-Connectivity Mode – Connect the mouse via Razer HyperSpeed Wireless (2.4 GHz), Bluetooth or Wired USB C (for continued usage while charging). Enjoy up to 140 hours on 2.4 GHz, or 210 hours on Bluetooth.
    • Razer Hypershift – Assign a secondary function to each of the mouse’s 13 controls via Synapse and effectively double your command. Instantly toggle between functions with a touch of a button.
